title: Tenure Credit Schedule: Photo-Review Claims (Cartwise Grocery Orders)
content:
# Tenure credit schedule: photo-review claims (Cartwise Grocery Orders)

**Schedule.** On a Cartwise Grocery Orders photo-review claim, when the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order was enrolled at least 48 whole calendar months before the order's placed date, a tenure credit of 2.00 is added to the claim amount; when it was enrolled at least 24 and fewer than 48 whole calendar months before, the credit is 1.00; otherwise, or when no membership is recorded on the order, there is none. The credit is added after the claim figure is rounded to the cent.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date. The earlier date is the membership's enrolled date; the later date is the date the order was placed.

| Whole months from enrolled date to placed date | Credit |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 2.00 |
| 24 to 47 | 1.00 |
| Fewer than 24 | None |
| No membership recorded on the order | None |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical dates)

| Enrolled | Order placed | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 February 2022 | 3 February 2026 | 48 | 2.00 |
| 3 February 2022 | 2 February 2026 | 47 | 1.00 |
| 3 February 2024 | 3 February 2026 | 24 | 1.00 |
| 3 February 2024 | 2 February 2026 | 23 | None |
